title: "Day 2 / Morning: Extra examples"

## Limits

1. Evaluate:
$$
\lim_{x\to 3}(2x^2-5x+1)
$$

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Solution
$$
\lim_{x\to 3}(2x^2-5x+1) = 2(3)^2-5(3)+1 = 18-15+1 = 4
$$
:::

2. Does the following limit exist?
$$
\lim_{x\to 1}\frac{|x-1|}{x-1}
$$

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Solution
Approaching from the right ($x>1$): $\frac{x-1}{x-1}=1$.

Approaching from the left ($x<1$): $\frac{-(x-1)}{x-1}=-1$.

Since the function approaches different values from the left and right, the limit **does not exist**.
:::

3. Evaluate:
$$
\lim_{x\to -2}(x^3+4x-1)
$$

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Solution
$$
\lim_{x\to -2}(x^3+4x-1) = (-2)^3+4(-2)-1 = -8-8-1 = -17
$$
:::

4. Let
$$
f(x)=\begin{cases}x+1, & x\geq 0\\-x+1, & x<0\end{cases}
$$
Does the following limit exist?
$$
\lim_{x\to 0}f(x)
$$

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Solution
Approaching from the right ($x\geq 0$): $f(x)=x+1 \to 1$.

Approaching from the left ($x<0$): $f(x)=-x+1 \to 1$.

Since the function approaches the same value from both sides, the limit **exists** and equals $1$.
:::

## Rules for differentiation

5. Find $f'(x)$ for $f(x)=x^5$

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Solution
$$
f'(x)=5x^4
$$
:::

6. Find $f'(x)$ for $f(x)=\frac{1}{x^2}$

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Solution
$$
f(x)=x^{-2} \Rightarrow f'(x)=-2x^{-3}=-\frac{2}{x^3}
$$
:::

7. Find $y'$ for $y=x^3-x^2-15$

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Solution
$$
y'=3x^2-2x
$$
:::

8. Find $\frac{dy}{dx}$ for $y=x^2+\sqrt{2}x-\frac{8}{x}+4$

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Solution
$$
\frac{dy}{dx}=2x+\sqrt{2}+\frac{8}{x^2}
$$
:::

9. Find $g'(y)$ for $g(y)=2\sqrt{y}-e^y+20\ln(y)$

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Solution
$$
g'(y)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{y}}-e^y+\frac{20}{y}
$$
:::

## Higher-order derivatives

10. Find the third derivative of $H(z)=2z^5-4z^3+6z-7$

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Solution
$$
H'(z)=10z^4-12z^2+6
$$
$$
H''(z)=40z^3-24z
$$
$$
H'''(z)=120z^2-24
$$
:::

11. Position is given by $s(t)=t^3-6t^2+9t$. Find the velocity function $s'(t)$ and the acceleration function $s''(t)$.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Solution
$$
v(t)=s'(t)=3t^2-12t+9
$$
$$
a(t)=s''(t)=6t-12
$$
:::

## Partial derivatives

12. Find $\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}$ and $\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}$ for $f(x,y)=x^2y-2x+y-1$, then evaluate both at $(1,3)$.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Solution
$$
\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}=2xy-2, \qquad \frac{\partial f}{\partial y}=x^2+1
$$
At $(1,3)$: $\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,3)}=2(1)(3)-2=4$, and $\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\right|_{(1,3)}=1^2+1=2$
:::

13. Find $\frac{\partial B}{\partial x}$, $\frac{\partial B}{\partial y}$, and $\frac{\partial B}{\partial z}$ for $B(x,y,z)=0.4x^3y-3.6y^2+4zx+8$

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Solution
$$
\frac{\partial B}{\partial x}=1.2x^2y+4z, \qquad \frac{\partial B}{\partial y}=0.4x^3-7.2y, \qquad \frac{\partial B}{\partial z}=4x
$$
:::
